name: Jurassic Park
hook: Crichton's cloned dinosaurs became Spielberg's record-breaking blockbuster — and a franchise.

facts.label: Michael Crichton
facts.statement: Michael Crichton wrote the 1990 bestseller, and its only sequel was The Lost World; he also created the TV series ER.

facts.label: Steven Spielberg
facts.statement: Steven Spielberg's 1993 film became the highest-grossing movie ever, passing E.T., and won three technical Oscars.

facts.label: Velociraptor
facts.statement: The film's ferocious predator is the Velociraptor, whose name means "swift robber" and which had a killing claw on each foot.

facts.label: amber
facts.statement: The park's dinosaurs are revived from DNA preserved in amber, fossilized tree resin.

facts.label: Sam Neill
facts.statement: Sam Neill played paleontologist Alan Grant, Jeff Goldblum played Ian Malcolm, and Laura Dern played paleobotanist Ellie Sattler.

facts.label: John Williams
facts.statement: John Williams composed the score; he had been a studio pianist on West Side Story and To Kill a Mockingbird.

facts.label: Richard Attenborough
facts.statement: Richard Attenborough, who directed Gandhi, played park founder John Hammond.
